name: LoveGiving
shortDescription: A UK online-giving and Gift Aid platform, built by ExpensePlus, for churches and charities that already use ExpensePlus fund accounting.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking branded online donation pages and fund-specific links
Finance teams that want the donation and Gift Aid workflow within their ExpensePlus records

pricing.summary: LoveGiving publishes a worked example of 2.2% plus 20p for a £20 Gift Aid donation, totalling 64p. It uses Stripe to process payments and is currently available only to ExpensePlus customers; confirm the current ExpensePlus subscription, payment-processor rates, card-country pricing, VAT and refund costs for the church's situation.

tiers.label: Published worked example
tiers.detail: Supplier's stated fee example for a £20 donation with Gift Aid; the example produces a 64p fee.

gdprInformation: LoveGiving's reviewed product pages identify ExpensePlus as the operator and Stripe as the payment processor, but they do not establish a complete LoveGiving-specific processing, hosting, sub-processor, retention or deletion position. Obtain the current ExpensePlus and Stripe contractual material, and test the church's donor-information and Gift Aid workflow before going live.
importExport: Supplier describes donation details and reports within ExpensePlus
Test the precise donation, Gift Aid, donor and reconciliation exports required by the church before adoption
support: Supplier directs LoveGiving questions to ExpensePlus
Implementation, payment support, migration and response arrangements should be confirmed directly

uk-operator.value: LoveGiving states that it is designed and built by ExpensePlus Ltd, registered in England and Wales under number 09404009.

church-eligibility.value: Supplier says that LoveGiving is used by churches and charities, and is currently available only to organisations using ExpensePlus.

giving-workflow.value: Supplier describes branded giving pages, one-off and recurring donations, automated Gift Aid and ExpensePlus integration; its support material describes fund-specific links and multi-site options.

published-fee-example.value: Supplier gives a fee example of 2.2% plus 20p for a £20 donation with Gift Aid, totalling 64p.

editorial.assessment: LoveGiving is not a standalone donation platform: it is the online-giving module for ExpensePlus customers. That constraint can be a strength for a church that already relies on ExpensePlus, because donation, fund and Gift Aid information can be handled in the same operating environment. It is less suitable for a church that wants a separate giving service, and the full payment, data-processing and exit arrangement should be understood across both ExpensePlus and Stripe.
bestFor: Churches needing fund-specific, branded links alongside their ExpensePlus finance workflow
Teams wanting an online Gift Aid declaration journey connected to their donation records
strengths: Supplier publishes a worked GBP fee example
One-off, recurring, fund-specific and multi-site donation options are documented
limitations: Currently available only to ExpensePlus customers
It is an online-giving module, not a complete contactless-hardware or church-management platform
Stripe payment-processing terms and costs remain part of the purchasing decision
Public product pages do not establish complete current hosting, sub-processor, retention, deletion or export detail

procurementVerdict.problem: Adding branded online giving and Gift Aid to an existing ExpensePlus finance process
procurementVerdict.differentiator: An ExpensePlus-native donation module with fund-specific links and supplier-described Gift Aid capture
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Use a test fund to check Stripe connection, donation page accessibility, recurring-gift control, Gift Aid declaration, reconciliation, refunds and the reports the church actually needs
